_doc: A TowerPro SG90 9 g servo. Its clones vary, so measure the one you have before cutting a tight slot. kind as in x1c.json. Mounting face at z = 0, shaft up +z from the origin. The face at z = 0 is the underside of the tabs; the body goes down through the plate.
name: sg90

type.rule: A position servo: it turns to an angle and holds it
type.source: TowerPro SG90 digital servo data sheet (dimensions A to F), https://www.rcscomponents.kiev.ua/datasheets/SG90_Digital-info.pdf

boss_diameter.rule: Boss round the output, about the case's width

boss_offset.rule: The output is this far from the case's centre, towards one end (6 mm from that end)

shaft_diameter.rule: Output spline outside diameter (21 teeth, finer than a printer draws: drive it through a horn)

shaft_flats.source: TowerPro SG90 digital servo data sheet (dimensions A to F), https://www.rcscomponents.kiev.ua/datasheets/SG90_Digital-info.pdf
